name: Pregnancy
source:
'Pregnancy' is an interactive short story where the player tries to influence the decisions of a 14 year old girl about the future of her pregnancy.

Lilla Sandor is the protagonist of 'Pregnancy'. She is a 14 year old girl who lives in Keszthely, Hungary. Lilla gets pregnant after being raped by a criminal and she is confused about what to do with the child she carries in her womb. The player acts as the voice of conscience influencing and guiding the young girl's decisions.

[From [url=http://www.locomotivah.com/pregnancy/]Official page[/url]]
translation:
《怀孕》是一篇互动短篇故事，玩家需要影响一名14岁女孩对自己妊娠未来的决定。

莉拉·尚多尔是《怀孕》的主角。她是一名居住在匈牙利凯斯特海伊的14岁女孩。莉拉被罪犯强奸后怀孕，不知道该如何面对腹中的孩子。玩家将扮演良知之声，影响并引导女孩做出选择。

[来源：[url=http://www.locomotivah.com/pregnancy/]官方页面[/url]]
